scope: one repeat launch per app, private nested Sway software rendering, three-second settle and 30-second idle sample, no input
limits: These are single repeat samples of the installed binaries, not warm-launch percentiles or an installed-desktop measurement.
Nested Sway uses software rendering; context switches are a wake-up proxy, not rendered frames.
The repeat establishes the high idle CPU is reproducible in the same private setup, not its cause.
